Choisir un dépôt (barre du haut, ou depu: Choosing a repository (top bar, or from a module) publishes it to every module, like Visual Studio's sync with the active document. Native modules already follow it; embedded modules will once they talk to the suite.
Comme les dispositions de fenêtre de Vis: Like Visual Studio's window layouts: several named layouts, and one per screen setup, applied automatically when screens are plugged in.
Compagnon fawkes-tailnet.exe introuvable: Companion fawkes-tailnet.exe not found: build it in Fawkes (tools\compagnon.ps1) or point FAWKES_TAILNET_EXE to it.

Dans la suite, thème, langue, comptes et: In the suite, theme, language, accounts and Tailscale are shared by all modules. Run on its own, each module keeps its own settings: they are neither read nor overwritten here.
Dans le module lui-même (son menu Réglag: In the module itself (its Settings menu, in its pane).
Demande poliment à l'exe autonome de se: Politely asks the standalone exe to close (it stays in control to save).
Détacher la case dans une fenêtre: Detach the pane into a window
Entre deux modules, la même combinaison: Between two modules, the same shortcut runs the action of the module that has the keyboard. When the suite claims it, the suite wins: the module no longer receives it.
La mémoire n'est pas mesurable par modul: Memory cannot be measured per module in a single process; time can.
La suite est traduite ; parmi les module: The suite is translated; among the modules, only DragonTree is today (the other five are in French, translating them is a separate project).
La suite peut reprendre les comptes de D: The suite can take over DragonTree's and Owlery's accounts (a copy: the executables keep theirs).
Lancé seul, un module garde ses propres: Run on its own, a module keeps its own settings; in the suite, it follows the suite's. A module never runs twice on the same state folder.
Le module continue de tourner ; rouvrez-: The module keeps running; reopen it from the activity bar.
Le module qui a le clavier : celui de la: The module that has the keyboard: the one whose pane was clicked last. The others see no keystroke.
Le module qui a le clavier est celui de: The module that has the keyboard is the one whose pane was clicked last: the others see no keystroke. The suite's shortcuts always come before the modules'.
Les cases de la fenêtre principale et le: The main window's panes and the detached windows, under a name.
Les comptes de la suite : la liste sans: The suite's accounts: the list, without tokens, in the suite's folder; the tokens in the Windows Credential Manager (service "SuperApp"). Each account is shared module by module.
Les modules réunis dans une seule applic: The modules together in one application: lay them out in panes, as tabs or in a grid, detach them into their own window for a second screen. Each module keeps its executable: run on its own, it uses its own settings.
Les trois thèmes de Fawkes (contrastes W: Fawkes's three themes (WCAG contrasts checked). System follows Windows: Graphite when dark, Fluent when light. Embedded modules follow the suite's palette wherever they read egui's style (DragonTree, Owlery); Fawkes follows the chosen theme; the others keep their own colors in their views.
Native module: written for the suite.
Native module, written for the suite.
Mêmes groupes, terminaux, tâches et filt: Same groups, terminals, tasks and filters on both sides. The suite holds each exe's lock: a module never runs twice on the same folder.
Ouvrez un module depuis la barre d'activ: Open a module from the activity bar, or choose a layout.
Owlery lit déjà les comptes partagés ave: Owlery already reads the accounts shared with it (its vault is injectable). DragonTree and Patronus will read them once they talk to the suite; Grimoire's Claude profiles are another kind of account, planned.
Où les modules embarqués rangent leur ét: Where embedded modules keep their state (Settings > General).
Palette de commandes : modules, cases, d: Command palette: modules, panes, layouts, settings
Polices remplacées par un module : rétab: Fonts replaced by a module: restored.
Pour essayer sans toucher aux données de: To try things without touching everyday data:
Premier jet : l'hôte et les modules réun: First draft: the host and the modules together, without changing the modules' code.
Takes effect at the next launch.

Ses réglages propres restent dans son pr: Its own settings stay in its own menu, in its pane; the suite's (theme, language, accounts, Tailscale) apply wherever it can follow them.
Tous les modules partagent un processus: All modules share one process: time spent by each, every frame.
Tout ou partie des modules : un module d: All modules or only some: a disabled module is not built and costs nothing. Modules are compiled into the suite; adding one does not require touching the others. Enabling or stopping a module takes effect immediately.
Tout remettre dans la fenêtre principale: Move everything back to the main window
Un dossier d'essai propre à la suite: A trial folder of the suite's own
Un dossier d'essai propre à la suite (po: A trial folder of the suite's own (to try without touching anything)
Un module désactivé n'est pas construit: A disabled module is not built and costs nothing.
Un routeur par module (/fawkes, /owlery…: A router per module (/fawkes, /owlery…) is planned behind this node.
Un seul centre pour tous les modules (Ow: One center for every module (Owlery, Patronus and the suite write to it).
Un seul nœud pour la suite (et non un pa: A single node for the suite (not one per module), for mobile sync. Fawkes's companion becomes the suite's; Fawkes run on its own keeps its own node.
